verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own developer docs show a broad API surface that covers many UI workflows: prompt-to-video with full avatar/voice/style control, Video Agent storyboard iteration and scene-level revision, photo avatars, cinematic avatars, LiveAvatar, account/credit info, scoped keys, batch calls, and an official MCP server and CLI. However, nothing documents parity with the UI, and several UI features have no API evidence, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm the full surface. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for brand kit/asset library, translation-script editing, SCORM export, and workspace/role management, and a published OpenAPI spec or independent verification of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create videos from a text prompt with full control over avatar, voice, style, and file inputs.
Review storyboards, send follow-up messages, and iterate with the Video Agent before generating.
Every endpoint ships with an MCP server, llms.txt, and typed schemas
Retrieve the authenticated user's profile, credit balance, and plan tier
